page.layout: One page of text in one column, with a woodcut ornament below it. The running head is at the top, with the page number beside it. Show-through from the other side is faint below the text and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: vole forte excepturus sit. Subterfugia frustra quæ-ret, frustra cum Reformatis consensum prætendet, aut communione sua probatum dare conabitur. Dis-sensum manifestissimum vidimus, quem in bonam partem sumere, quantumvis eum palliaverit, vel ideo quod Reformatos, ut à se diversos, sæpissime, Cal-vinianorum nomine characteristico, non sine probro insigniverit, vix poterit vel indulgentissimus.

page.notes: A woodcut ornament (a cartouche with scrollwork, foliage, fruit and a mask) stands in the middle of the page below the text; it carries no words. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and is left out. No catchword or signature is printed. The first word "vole" is the end of a sentence begun on the previous page and is read as printed.
